scope: One additional English definition field after the first accepted reopens; original57-row receipt and all source/general first-pass artifacts retained.

before.meaningEn: (adv.) no more than; (adj.) the single one; (conj.) but; with nevertheless the final result; in the final outcome

after.meaningEn: (adv.) no more than; merely. (adj.) the single one, or emphatically the best. (conj.) but or except that. Separately, only to + verb introduces a subsequent, often unexpected result.

patches.reason: Separate the inherited unexpected-result construction only to + verb from conjunction only=but, and preserve the directly attested emphatic best adjective. All formal identities/POS/status and practice wording remain unchanged.
patches.evidence: https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/only; existing unchanged note NXbed06ea4 distinguishes only to + verb from purpose.
